payload.name: local-file-streaming-multihash
payload.description: Hash a selected allowed regular file through the canonical native held-file hash owner using bounded memory. Return only path, length, multihash and matching before/after revision identities; refuse concurrent changes. No whole-file copy or content is returned.

payload.source_ref_contract: Local source refs published to production contain durable artifact or stored-bytes refs. Machine-specific file names and selectors remain local-files internals.

invariants: digest is calculated from selected bytes

payload.name: record-selected-addressed-evidence
payload.description: Create the durable Local Files custody receipt for one already-staged immutable artifact. The receipt is create-only and binds evidence identity to artifact identity, digest, byte length, and media type.

things._comment: Unregistered until 2026-09-05, which cost more than the row is worth: one day after this script shipped, a convergence was opened to BUILD it, because a file nothing declares is reachable only by somebody who already knows its name. The convergence returned DO NOT BUILD and found ten referrers plus a knowledge leaf prescribing it, none of which a package-set reader can see. A capability that exists and is undeclared reads exactly like a capability that is missing.
things.name: ask-local-file-content-digest-script

payload.name: local-file-content-digest
payload.description: Return the byte length and caller-selected digest of one authorized inline-size local file without returning its bytes. The file is read only through local.files; its native inline-size refusal protects large assets, and a leaf process hashes one ephemeral mounted copy.

payload.name: read-local-file
payload.description: Read one authorized local file through the native local.files owner. The native target retains all path, picker, inline-size, and containment enforcement.

payload.name: read-local-file-range
payload.description: Read a bounded range from one authorized local file through local.files. This is the declared replacement for agent-owned cat/sed/head/tail reads.

payload.name: list-local-directory
payload.description: List one authorized local directory through local.files. This is the declared replacement for agent-owned ls/find path discovery.

payload.name: scan-local-files
payload.description: Recursively enumerate a bounded glob of authorized local files through the native local.files owner, newest first, with optional bounded inline bytes. The native owner retains path containment, traversal, symlink, count, depth, and byte-budget enforcement.

payload.name: move-local-path-to-trash
payload.description: Move one authorized local path to the operating-system Trash through local.files. This is the declared replacement for raw rm/shell deletion.

operations.publication: Atomic no-replace publication of synced sibling bytes; existing destinations are preserved and failed staging is retained for recovery.
atomic same-directory rename after full write and sync

operations.reply_shape: the reply payload IS the requested range
operations.why: the JSON reply base64-encodes every byte, so a caller that wants bytes pays an encode, a JSON parse with UTF-8 validation over all of it, and a decode. This operation shares the same allowed-roots containment, the same clamp to end of file, and the same max_range_bytes.

operations.reply_shape: the reply payload IS the complete stable file
operations.why: A workflow that materializes selected local bytes must not reopen the host path inside an isolated process. The native owner opens one canonical non-symlink regular file, captures its complete bytes, re-reads the held descriptor, and rejects any descriptor or named-path identity change before returning bytes. A second hardlink does not weaken this: link count is pinned and a write through any name changes the held inode or bytes and is rejected.

payload.name: write-local-file
payload.description: Write bytes to one authorized local file through local.files. Atomic same-directory rename after full write and sync.

payload.name: write-new-local-file
payload.description: Save a new local file without replacing an existing file. Failed publication keeps the staged bytes for recovery.
